info.name: CityCare - City Complaint Management System (Local)
info.description:
Complete API collection for CityCare backend. All endpoints use the consistent response envelope: success { success, statusCode, message, data, meta? } / error { success, statusCode, message, errors }.

AUTH: Login/verify-email set httpOnly cookies (accessToken/refreshToken) — Postman's cookie jar handles them automatically per request.

WORKFLOW: Login as Admin → pick departmentId/categoryId/wardId from GET endpoints → set collection variables → Citizen creates request → Admin routes/assigns → Staff changes status & adds updates → Citizen gives feedback (after RESOLVED/CLOSED). Notifications are created automatically by business events.

request.description: CITIZEN only. Auto-generates requestNo, SLA due dates, location, initial route + REQUEST_CREATED notification. Copy the created id into {{requestId}}. type ∈ COMPLAINT | SERVICE | INFORMATION.
ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN/STAFF. STAFF sees only their departments' requests.
CITIZEN only. Same filters as list-all.
Includes citizen, category+department, currentDepartment and reportedLocation+ward.
Merged event stream: SUBMITTED | ROUTED | STATUS_CHANGED | ASSIGNED | RELEASED, time-sorted.
ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN/STAFF. Transfers the request to another department and updates currentDepartmentId.
ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN/STAFF. Oldest first. Copy a route id into {{routeId}}.
ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN only. Sets endedAt.
ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN/STAFF. Assignee must be active staff of the request's CURRENT department. Moves status to ASSIGNED + fires notifications. Copy the created id into {{assignmentId}}.
When no active assignments remain, status reverts to UNDER_REVIEW automatically.

ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN/STAFF. Valid transitions: SUBMITTED→UNDER_REVIEW|REJECTED · UNDER_REVIEW→ASSIGNED|PENDING|REJECTED · ASSIGNED→IN_PROGRESS|UNDER_REVIEW · IN_PROGRESS→RESOLVED|PENDING|UNDER_REVIEW · PENDING→IN_PROGRESS|UNDER_REVIEW|REJECTED · RESOLVED→CLOSED|REOPENED · REOPENED→UNDER_REVIEW|ASSIGNED|IN_PROGRESS · CLOSED→REOPENED · REJECTED terminal. Sets firstRespondedAt/resolvedAt/closedAt automatically.
Any role (citizen sees own request only, staff their departments).
ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN/STAFF. visibleToCitizen defaults false. note max 2000 chars.

multipart/form-data with key file. purpose ∈ EVIDENCE | DOCUMENT | PHOTO | RECEIPT | OTHER (default OTHER). Files go to Cloudinary. Copy the created id into {{attachmentId}}.

Each user sees only their own, newest first. Notifications are auto-created by business events: REQUEST_CREATED (citizen), REQUEST_ASSIGNED (assignee), STATUS_CHANGED (citizen + staff). Copy one id into {{notificationId}}.
Marks every unread notification of the logged-in user. Returns { count }.
Owner only. Fails if already read.
CITIZEN only, own request, and only when status is RESOLVED or CLOSED. rating 1–5 integer. One feedback per request (requestId unique).
Any role within access scope. Returns data: null when not submitted yet.
Admin or Staff issues a payment fee/bill for a service request. Triggers PAYMENT_REQUIRED notification to citizen and creates audit log.
Citizen initiates bKash tokenized checkout session. Backend calls bKash /checkout/create and returns checkoutUrl (bkashURL) to redirect citizen.
bKash redirects user here after entering PIN. Executes payment via bKash /checkout/execute, updates payment to PAID, and notifies citizen.
Citizen retrieves their payment bills and transaction history with pagination.
Admin or Staff lists all payments with optional filtering by status, requestId, or purpose.
Fetches complete payment details including linked service request, transactions, and event audit history.
Admin refunds a previously PAID invoice via bKash /checkout/payment/refund. Marks status as REFUNDED and creates audit log.
Admin queries system audit trails with pagination and filtering by action, entityType, and actorId.
